quotes.text: Bronze pipelines are not temporary throwaway scripts. They live longer than you think, and if they're not branchable, reviewable, and version controlled, they'll eventually blow up.

quotes.text: If you don't enforced discipline, CIICD doesn't prevent chaos, It just automates it faster. And the truth is, most blow ups aren't some exotic zero day bug.

takeaways: Treat every medallion layer, from bronze ingestion to gold analytics, as code in source control with branching and reviews.
Never promote a change without automated schema and data quality tests, approval gates and a one-step rollback to the last good build.
Use the tools together: GitHub for collaboration, Fabric deployment features for packaging, and Azure DevOps for governance and approvals.
hook: Without CI/CD, a medallion architecture in Fabric Warehouse quickly turns into an expensive data swamp. This episode shows data engineers how to version, test and promote bronze, silver and gold layers, and how GitHub, Azure DevOps and Fabric share the work.
